turns.content: Hi IVARA! Good to meet you.
Hello! It is a pleasure to meet you. How can I assist you today?
I was born in Chandigarh on August 14, 1999.
Nice to know! You were born in Chandigarh on August 14, 1999.
I completed my B.Tech in Computer Science from ABV IIITM Gwalior in June 2022.
Understood, B.Tech in CS from ABV IIITM Gwalior graduated in June 2022.
My college roommate was Rohan Sharma. We lived in Hostel 3.
Recorded: Rohan Sharma was your college roommate in Hostel 3 at IIITM Gwalior.
I currently live in Indiranagar, Bengaluru with my rescue indie dog named Kaalu.
Noted, you live in Indiranagar, Bengaluru with your rescue dog Kaalu.
I prefer reading physical books over e-readers for technical subjects.

title: HyperScale Systems Job and Early Architecture

turns.content: Hey IVARA, just getting back from work.
Welcome back! How was your work day?
I joined HyperScale Systems in Bengaluru as an Associate Software Engineer back in July 2022.
Got it: Joined HyperScale Systems in July 2022 as Associate Software Engineer.
My engineering manager at HyperScale is Vikram Rao.
Recorded: Vikram Rao is your engineering manager at HyperScale.
I am working with senior staff engineer Deepa Nair on our distributed caching layer called CacheMesh.
Noted: Collaborating with Deepa Nair on CacheMesh at HyperScale.
We built CacheMesh using Redis cluster and Go.
Recorded: CacheMesh is built using Redis cluster and Go.
I dislike Kubernetes complexity and prefer lightweight Docker Compose for local service development.
Noted your preference for Docker Compose over Kubernetes for local dev.
I decided to adopt Neovim configured with Lua as my primary code editor.

title: Smart India Hackathon and AgriVision Project

turns.content: Had an exciting weekend with my old college crew!
That sounds great! What did you do with your college friends?
I participated in the Smart India Hackathon alumni track with Rohan Sharma and Meera Sen.
Recorded: Participated in SIH alumni track with Rohan Sharma and Meera Sen.
Our team name was MatrixCrafters and we built AgriVision, an edge-AI crop disease diagnosis mobile app.
Got it: Team MatrixCrafters developed AgriVision for edge-AI crop disease diagnosis.
Meera Sen built the Flutter mobile frontend, Rohan managed the FastAPI cloud backend, and I trained the PyTorch Mobile vision model.
Understood the division of roles: Meera on Flutter frontend, Rohan on FastAPI backend, and you on PyTorch Mobile vision model.
Our project AgriVision won the 2nd runner-up prize of 1,500 dollars at SIH.
Congratulations! Won 2nd runner-up prize ($1,500) for AgriVision.
Meera is strictly allergic to peanuts, so we celebrated with peanut-free Italian food.
Noted Meera Sen's severe peanut allergy constraint.
I bought a 16-inch MacBook Pro M3 Max to run local model evaluations.

title: Relocation to HSR Layout, Diet and Sports

turns.content: I moved from Indiranagar to HSR Layout Sector 2 in Bengaluru this month.
Updated your residence: Moved from Indiranagar to HSR Layout Sector 2, Bengaluru.
I moved to HSR Layout to be closer to Rohan and our badminton club.
Noted: Relocation motivated by proximity to Rohan and badminton club.
I play badminton every Tuesday evening at PlayArena with Rohan Sharma.
Recorded: Badminton every Tuesday evening at PlayArena with Rohan.
I adopted a strict vegetarian diet starting in November 2024.
Recorded your dietary change: Strict vegetarian since November 2024.
I have set a personal fitness goal to complete a 10k marathon by late 2025.
Fitness goal recorded: Complete a 10k marathon by late 2025.
I tried learning German on Duolingo for 40 days, but I gave up and dropped it due to work overload.
Big career update to share with you!
Exciting! What is the career update?
I resigned from HyperScale Systems in January 2025.
Recorded: Resigned from HyperScale Systems in January 2025.
HyperScale offered me a 30 percent salary raise to stay, but I declined their counter-offer.
Noted: Declined HyperScale's 30% raise counter-offer.
I joined Aetheria AI, a generative AI research startup in Koramangala, as a Research Engineer on February 1, 2025.
Congratulations! Joined Aetheria AI in Koramangala as Research Engineer on February 1, 2025.
My new CTO at Aetheria AI is Dr. Shalini Verma, who previously led research at FAIR.
Recorded: Dr. Shalini Verma is your CTO at Aetheria AI.
I signed a non-compete clause with HyperScale barring me from consulting for competing database and caching companies for 12 months.
At Aetheria AI, I am working on NeuroCompact, a 4-bit quantizer for speculative decoding.
Recorded: Developing NeuroCompact, a 4-bit quantizer for speculative decoding at Aetheria AI.
I am collaborating on NeuroCompact directly with compiler engineer Kabir Das and Dr. Shalini Verma.
Collaborators recorded: Working on NeuroCompact with Kabir Das and Dr. Shalini Verma.
We decided to rewrite our CUDA execution kernels in Mojo instead of Python.
Architecture decision: Rewriting CUDA execution kernels in Mojo.
I never drink coffee because it gives me migraines; I strictly drink masala chai.
Noted beverage preference: No coffee due to migraines, strictly masala chai.
Our research goal is to submit our empirical findings on NeuroCompact to EMNLP 2025.

title: EMNLP Paper Rejection, Departure of Kabir, and Project Pivot

turns.content: Tough couple of weeks at the research lab.
Sorry to hear that. What happened at the lab?
Our EMNLP 2025 paper submission on NeuroCompact was rejected in August 2025 due to baseline benchmark leakage.
Noted: EMNLP 2025 submission rejected in August 2025 due to baseline leakage.
My collaborator Kabir Das left Aetheria AI in July 2025 to relocate to Vancouver, Canada.
Recorded: Kabir Das departed Aetheria AI in July 2025 to relocate to Vancouver, Canada.
Dr. Shalini Verma and I decided to pivot NeuroCompact from server speculative decoding to on-device memory compression.
Major project pivot: NeuroCompact shifted to on-device memory compression with Dr. Shalini Verma.
I reconnected with Meera Sen to help test on-device latency on real Android smartphones.
Collaboration: Meera Sen assisting with Android on-device latency testing.
I no longer use Mojo for kernel development; I switched back to C++ and PyTorch C++ API because the Mojo tooling was unstable.
I ran the Bengaluru 10k Marathon on November 9, 2025 and finished in 54 minutes!
Congratulations on finishing the Bengaluru 10k Marathon in 54 minutes on November 9, 2025!
Rohan Sharma started the race with me, but he twisted his ankle at kilometer 4 and could not complete the marathon.
Noted: Rohan Sharma twisted ankle at km 4 and DNF (did not finish).
I developed plantar fasciitis in my right heel after the run, and the sports doctor forbade high-impact running for 3 months.
Medical constraint: Plantar fasciitis, no high-impact running for 3 months.
I switched from running to swimming at the Padukone-Dravid Centre for Sports Excellence.
Activity update: Switched to swimming at Padukone-Dravid Centre.
I bought a Garmin Forerunner 265 watch to track my swim laps and heart rate.
Huge milestone for our research work!
Tell me all about it!
Our revised paper on NeuroCompact v2 was accepted as an Oral Presentation at MLSys 2026!
Outstanding achievement! NeuroCompact v2 accepted as an Oral Presentation at MLSys 2026.
We were awarded a 25,000 dollar research compute grant from the OpenCompute Foundation.
Recorded: $25,000 compute grant from OpenCompute Foundation.
Dr. Shalini Verma promoted me from Research Engineer to Lead Research Scientist at Aetheria AI in January 2026.
Congratulations on your promotion to Lead Research Scientist at Aetheria AI!
I hired and started mentoring a research intern named Ananya Bose who is working on memory-augmented transformers.
Aetheria AI is opening a European research hub in Zurich, Switzerland.
Noted: Aetheria AI opening a European research office in Zurich.
Dr. Shalini Verma gave me the option to stay in Bengaluru as regional lead or relocate to Zurich to head the efficiency lab.
Understood: Offered choice between staying in Bengaluru or heading Zurich lab.
I decided to relocate to Zurich in September 2026.
Major decision recorded: Relocating to Zurich in September 2026.
I enrolled in intensive German classes at the Goethe-Institut Bengaluru, reviving my language goal.
Goal revived: Intensive German classes at Goethe-Institut Bengaluru.
Kaalu will move with me to Switzerland; I completed his pet microchip and rabies titer test on April 5, 2026.
Recorded: Kaalu moving to Zurich with pet microchip and rabies titer completed April 5, 2026.
Rohan Sharma is staying in Bengaluru; he got engaged to Sneha Roy in March 2026.

title: Technology Stack Updates and Visa Obstacle

turns.content: I have completely phased out Redis in all my systems; I now strictly use Dragonfly and DuckDB.
Database stack update: Redis phased out, strictly using Dragonfly and DuckDB.
I was unable to attend MLSys 2026 in person in Santa Clara because my US B1/B2 visa was administratively delayed under 221g.
Travel constraint: US visa delayed under 221g, could not attend MLSys in person.
Dr. Shalini Verma traveled to California and delivered the NeuroCompact oral presentation on my behalf.
Recorded: Dr. Shalini Verma delivered the MLSys oral presentation on your behalf.
Ananya Bose completed her internship under my supervision and received a full-time Research Scientist offer at Aetheria AI.
Mentorship outcome: Ananya Bose completed internship and received full-time Research Scientist offer.
I have a strict professional policy: I refuse to work on closed-source military or defense surveillance contracts.

Welcome to Switzerland! Settled into Zurich Kreis 4 on September 15, 2026.
I work at the Aetheria Europe research office located on Technoparkstrasse in Zurich.
Workplace recorded: Aetheria Europe office on Technoparkstrasse, Zurich.
Kaalu is loving the autumn walks around Lake Zurich.
Delighted to hear Kaalu is enjoying Lake Zurich walks.
I missed Bengaluru masala chai, so I bought a traditional brass tea kettle to brew authentic chai at home.
Noted: Bought a traditional brass tea kettle to brew masala chai in Zurich.

Language progress: Studying for German B1 exam in Zurich.
My current diet remains strictly vegetarian, but I eat Swiss artisanal cheeses freely.

On weekends, I hike up Uetliberg and do cold water swimming in Lake Zurich.
